title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta5

## Persistent vendor current cycles and unbounded live tails

Pair with **Navimower 0.4.5-beta9** for persistent per-zone vendor geometry and ZoneLedger cycle identity.

- Remove the frontend 8 m MQTT-tail limit. Render the integration-owned unconfirmed tail and append browser-live samples only after its anchor.
- Treat an explicit empty persistent-backend tail as a confirmation; do not resurrect a previous server/browser tail.
- Scope tail state by zone, cycle and session, and suppress live overlays while docked/idle.
- Retain the last current-cycle SVG during lightweight map refreshes, request updated source revisions, and reject obsolete deferred results. Apply the same per-mower behavior in Multi mower view.
- Selecting a History session displays only that session's archive, hiding the cumulative current cycle and other session trails. Select a History day or Current cycle to leave the selection.
- Release preparation now only synchronizes the version and copies the cumulative source to dist; it cannot replay the removed beta4 tail cap.

The cumulative runtime regression suite covers unbounded tails, confirmation, History isolation in Single/Multi mower views and phased SVG retention. Physical mower, mobile and real Home Assistant UI checks remain field validation.
